Arbeidsvoorwaarden You will become part of Xelvin Portugal and work from our office in the Porto region. From Portugal, you will contribute to engineering projects for a Dutch customer, while being part of an international and growing engineering environment. We offer: Between 2000 and 2750 A challenging engineering role in offshore, marine and heavy lifting technology; The

opportunity to work for a leading Dutch company in high-end crane and hoisting equipment; A professional workplace in the Porto region; International collaboration with experienced engineers in the Netherlands; Room to grow technically and professionally; A role where your work directly contributes to safe and reliable lifting systems; Support from Xelvin Portugal during your onboarding and development. Functie-eisen We are looking for an engineer with a strong technical mindset and a practical approach to electrical design. Experience in heavy lifting or offshore/marine equipment is a plus, but not mandatory. Relevant experience in machine building, industrial automation, material handling, shipbuilding or heavy equipment is also highly valuable. You bring: At least 2 years of experience as an Electrical Design Engineer, EPLAN Engineer or similar; Good experience with EPLAN; A technical background in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a similar field; Experience with electrical schematics, control cabinets, cable lists, terminal diagrams and BOMs; Knowledge of industrial components such as drives, sensors, motors, safety relays, PLC I/O and control systems; An interest in working on cranes, hoisting systems and heavy lifting equipment; Good communication skills in English; A structured and accurate way of working; The ability to work independently while staying connected to an international project team. Nice to have The following experience is considered a plus: Experience with offshore, marine, cranes, hoisting systems or heavy machinery; Knowledge of standards such as IEC 60204-1, IEC 60204-32, EN ISO 13849 or IEC 62061; Experience with Siemens, ABB, Schneider, Rockwell, Pilz or similar systems; Experience with safety circuits, functional safety, drives or motor control; Interest in new technologies and future engineering possibilities, such as AI, automation tools or digital engineering workflows. Start your technical career in the Netherlands Are you an experienced Maintenance Technician based in Portugal and ready for an international step in your career? Xelvin is looking for motivated technical professionals who want to relocate to the Netherlands and work in industrial maintenance, production technology or technical service environments. In this role, you will work as part of a technical department and help keep machines, production lines and installations running smoothly. You will solve technical issues, carry out preventive maintenance and contribute to a safe, reliable and efficient production process. This position is suitable for technicians with experience in industrial maintenance, mechanics, electromechanics, automation or technical service. What you will do As a Maintenance Technician, you are responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving technical installations and production equipment. You will work in a practical, hands-on environment where no two days are the same. Your responsibilities may include: Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on machines, production lines and technical installations. Diagnosing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic faults. Repairing and replacing machine parts, sensors, motors, pumps, conveyors or other technical components. Supporting production teams when technical problems occur. Carrying out inspections and basic testing of equipment. Reading and using technical drawings, electrical diagrams or machine documentation. Registering maintenance activities and technical findings. Thinking along about improvements in reliability, safety and efficiency. Working according to safety standards and company procedures. Cooperating with colleagues from production, engineering and technical service. Depending on your experience, the role can be more mechanically, electrically or electromechanically focused. What Xelvin offers you Relocating to another country is a big step. Xelvin supports you

throughout the process, from the first interview to your first working day in the Netherlands. We offer: A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. Support during onboarding and your first period in the Netherlands. Personal guidance from Xelvin. Opportunities for training, courses and career development.
